title: Frozen out-of-design mechanism confirmation and decision-cost audit for PCHP
scope: protocol-locked external mechanism confirmation and operational decision analysis

chronology.classification: frozen out-of-design confirmation; not prospectively blinded acquisition

hypothesis: Across six heterogeneous external battery surfaces, record-specific PCHP updates improve cell-macro capacity-retention error over the exact development-selected constant shift allowed by the same harm budget, demonstrating value beyond uniform bias correction.

model_contract.protected_features: log1p target cycle number plus frozen early-charge features
model_contract.candidate_features: protected features plus signed raw-scale changes from each cell's first-five-record commissioning median
model_contract.candidate_weighting: equal total weight per development domain and physical cell

pchp_contract.alpha_origin: frozen canonical value and modal nested-development selection used by the existing external contract

fixed_shift_control.purpose: separate record-specific candidate value from a uniform safe bias correction
fixed_shift_control.selection_data: twelve-domain cross-fitted V322 development predictions only
fixed_shift_control.selection_rule: compute the domain-equal cell-weighted median of truth minus protected state, choose the first value whose cumulative normalized weight is at least 0.5, then clip to [-0.01, 0.01]
fixed_shift_control.execution: add the single selected shift to every external protected state and clip to [0, 1.3]

primary_estimand.name: surface-equal mean PCHP-minus-fixed-shift cell-macro MAE
primary_estimand.aggregation: mean record error within cell, mean cells within surface, mean surfaces
primary_estimand.interval: two-stage percentile bootstrap resampling surfaces and then cells within sampled surfaces

decision_cost_audit.scenario: at each fleet diagnostic checkpoint, continue routine operation or schedule a full diagnostic/maintenance review
decision_cost_audit.action_rule: schedule review when predicted capacity retention is at or below the threshold
decision_cost_audit.normalized_binary_cost: one unit for a premature review plus r units for a missed degraded state
decision_cost_audit.aggregation: cell-equal within surface and surface-equal across surfaces
decision_cost_audit.primary_decision_claim_gate: at threshold 0.8 and ratio 5, PCHP must have lower point cost than both protected state and fixed shift, and its two-stage 95% interval versus fixed shift must end below zero
decision_cost_audit.secondary_grid_role: prespecified sensitivity analysis; no multiplicity-adjusted efficacy claim

decision_rule.retain: all primary mechanism gates pass; decision benefit is claimed only if the separate primary decision-cost gate passes
decision_rule.narrow: if the mechanism gate fails, report the frozen result and do not claim external candidate-specific superiority; if only the decision gate fails, retain mechanism evidence but restrict decision discussion to the exact cost mapping and observed trade-off
decision_rule.reject: any deterministic harm, causality, monotonicity, range, or replay certificate fails
decision_rule.no_post_result_changes: do not alter surfaces, alpha, delta, control selection, thresholds, cost ratios, estimands, intervals, or gates after scoring
